mapper.select: SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CT_NOTICE_IDX) AS roNum, CT_NOTICE_IDX AS ctNoticeIdx, CT_NOTICE_SUBJECT AS ctNoticeSubject, CT_NOTICE_CONTENT AS ctNoticeSubject, CT_NOTICE_AUTHOR AS ctNoticeAuthor, CT_NOTICE_MODIFIER AS ctNoticeModifier, CT_NOTICE_CREATE_TIME AS ctNoticeCreateTime, CT_NOTICE_UPDATE_TIME AS ctNoticeUpdateTime FROM CT_NOTICE LIMIT #{begin},#{end}

SELECT CT_NOTICE_IDX AS ctNoticeIdx, CT_NOTICE_SUBJECT AS ctNoticeSubject, CT_NOTICE_CONTENT AS ctNoticeSubject, CT_NOTICE_AUTHOR AS ctNoticeAuthor, CT_NOTICE_MODIFIER AS ctNoticeModifier, CT_NOTICE_CREATE_TIME AS ctNoticeCreateTime, CT_NOTICE_UPDATE_TIME AS ctNoticeUpdateTime FROM CT_NOTICE WHERE CT_NOTICE_IDX = #{ctNoticeIdx}
